init_HighLevelPolicy: create a HighLevelPolicy instance with config, PDDL problem, skill mappings, and observation space
get_next_skill: get the next skill to execute given observations, hidden states, and plan masks
evaluate_actions: evaluate actions using observations, hidden states, previous actions, and masks for learning
get_termination: get a binary tensor indicating whether the currently executing skill should terminate
setup_actions: setup and return the list of all PDDL actions the agent can execute
